title: Core Book Chapter 6 — Magic Item Shortlist
audience: Core Book Author (Valtay); player-facing Core Rulebook
scope_note: Sits beside tables/item-reskins (191 mundane) and Floor 1 loot decks. Entries with deck_ref point at existing cards instead of rewriting them. Skip needs_verify and wiki-only catalog/items.md rows.

box_ceilings.F1-2: Silver ordinary; Legendary Story Boxes are special

entries.tier: F1–2 Legendary Story / Pet Box (Silver–Legendary special)
entries.flavor: It looks like a treat. It is a career change with teeth. Feed it only where the System cannot make the punchline worse.
entries.mechanics: See loot card f01-any-0055 and rules/42-house-items-f01.md §6 for table mechanics. Canon: Legendary Pet Box consumable that forces a major random pet outcome (100+ possibilities). Prefer a saferoom.
entries.notes: Do not reprint full rules; point to the card.

entries.tier: F1–2 Legendary Story Box (That's the Spirit!)
entries.flavor: Pretty little promise that someone, somewhere, is going to have a worse day than you. Wear it like a threat you can afford.
entries.mechanics: See loot card f01-any-0057. House adaptation of the Night Wyrm ring fantasy (I-025); printed table text is the card, not the novel.
entries.notes: Canon ring is I-025; this is the Floor 1 playable stand-in.

entries.flavor: Fits heads. Fits paws. Fits egos. The crown does not care which hole you call a face.
entries.mechanics: See loot card f01-any-0056. House quadruped crown inspired by I-014; use card mechanics at the table.

entries.flavor: A bag that lies about volume and tells the truth about your life choices. Do not put a bag inside a bag unless you enjoy becoming a cautionary tale.
entries.mechanics: See loot card f01-any-0052. SRD Bag of Holding: extradimensional storage with the usual catastrophic nesting rules.

entries.flavor: One shirt, infinite outfit crimes. The System finally found a use for laundry day.
entries.mechanics: See loot card f01-any-0028 (Cloak of Many Fashions house item; final text in rules/42 §2).

entries.flavor: Minty. Regretful. Briefly dragon-adjacent. Exhale problems at people who deserve them.
entries.mechanics: See loot card f01-any-0041 and rules/42 §5 (Potion of Fire Breath house item).

entries.tier: F1+ Adventurer / tutorial boxes; saferoom stock
entries.flavor: Not the polite red vial from tabletop night. This one negotiates with your hit points like a collections agent.
entries.mechanics: On drink, restore at least half your maximum hit points (dungeon formula). Distinct from the SRD Potion of Healing skins in the Floor 1 decks (those use SRD dice). Prefer this entry when printing DCC-native healing.

entries.tier: F1–3 Silver loot boxes (short shelf life)
entries.flavor: Tastes like someone left a debug menu open. Drink before it remembers it has a shelf life.
entries.mechanics: Grants +3 levels to one random skill. Perishable: GM may spoil unused doses after a short clock (canon warns of short shelf life).

entries.flavor: A pokéball with worse customer support. Your bonded pet goes in. Your dignity does not come out.
entries.mechanics: Lets a bonded pet-class creature ride in inventory safely. Ordinary healing potions still do not work on pets (see Heal Critter).

entries.tier: F1 Goblin / explosives boxes; Bomb Bard drops
entries.flavor: Lit fuse, bad manners, excellent peer pressure. The clan brought enough for everyone, including you.
entries.mechanics: Thrown explosive. Use alchemist's fire / goblin-bomb table rules from the house Floor 1 budget (or 5e thrown bomb guidelines). Inert inside saferooms (floor rule).

entries.display_name: Enchanted Toe Ring of the Leprous Bandit
entries.flavor: Yes, a toe ring. Yes, it is sticky. Yes, you will explain this at the table and nobody will respect you for it.
entries.mechanics: While attuned: gain a Sticky Feet benefit (advantage on checks to keep footing / resist being moved) and a Super Spreader benefit (when you inflict a contagion-style condition the GM tracks, it is easier to pass on—exact disease list is table-ruled). Unique-flavored jewelry.

entries.flavor: Permanent ink that says you are union-adjacent to the worst roommates in the dungeon. Job interviews are over.
entries.mechanics: Removes automatic goblin hostility and grants free passage through goblin-controlled areas that recognize the mark. Does not stop goblins who already hate you personally.

entries.flavor: Back-of-the-bus club stamp. The nice clubs will smell it on you.
entries.mechanics: Grants Desperado Club access when that venue is in play. If the Crawler already holds another club affiliation, the GM may skip or replace this drop (L-019).

entries.flavor: Because the System decided pets do not deserve normal medicine. Brew it ugly. Make the pet drink it.
entries.mechanics: Heals pet-class creatures. Standard healing potions and heal scrolls do nothing for pets. Field recipe (paraphrase): spike a Healing Potion with cinnamon, wait briefly, add Thistle Rot, shake until brown; the pet must consume it.

entries.tier: F1 Pet Box (bulk); F2 pound puzzle
entries.flavor: Dog treat diplomacy. Works until it doesn't. Bulk crates exist for people who collect problems.
entries.mechanics: Feed to a qualifying beast/pet to shift hostility toward neutral in the Floor 2 pound scenario (map dot red→white). Bulk supply appears in Legendary Pet Box samples (500) and card f01-any-0060.

entries.flavor: Accelerant first, beverage second, life coach never. The label is lying about every word except "toilet."
entries.mechanics: Volatile potion/accelerant. On drink: high chance of a permanent +2 to a random ability score, small chance of instant death, and other nasty side effects the GM rolls from the Rev-Up table. Also a crafting reagent for Floor 2 recipes.

entries.flavor: Blended corpse cocktail with a buzz chaser. Prevents the floor's favorite diseases. Does not fix your taste.
entries.mechanics: While the temporary immunity lasts: ignore Taint and Vigorous Measles (prevention, not cure of an already-active case per M-455). Inflicts a Buzzed debuff. Brewed at the Floor 2 blender station from moonshine plus a Laminak Elite corpse (see K-123).

entries.flavor: Moonshine jug, goblin oil, torch cork, and a prayer you do not owe anyone. Incendiary handling optional, survival mandatory.
entries.mechanics: Crafted incendiary jug. Burns in a splash radius for a duration based on the thrower's Incendiary Device Handling skill (about 15 seconds per skill level). Use thrown-bomb attack rolls; saferoom-inert.

entries.flavor: Thirty seconds of "no." Then the bill comes due. Drink only when dying would be embarrassing on camera.
entries.mechanics: For 30 seconds after drinking, the Crawler cannot be killed (treat as immortality/ignore HP 0 for the duration). When it ends, normal death rules resume immediately.

entries.flavor: Bottled homework credit. The System hates giving these out almost as much as you love drinking them.
entries.mechanics: Grants +1 character level when drunk. Quest-gated; do not stock on Floor 1–2 random Silver.

entries.flavor: Pink, frothy, and personally invasive. One stat gets a vacation. The others get jealous.
entries.mechanics: Immediately increase one random ability score by +10 (permanent unless the table rules otherwise). Late-floor Platinum specialty.

entries.flavor: Makes your bolt believe in itself. Physics files a complaint.
entries.mechanics: Applied to a projectile: that shot gains the Guided property (ignore ordinary cover/soft miss chances; still requires a legal target and attack roll). One application per kit use.

entries.flavor: A sleeveless jacket that collects upgrade patches like bad decisions. Fashion for people who blow things up on purpose.
entries.mechanics: Chest slot. While worn and attuned: +1 to each of Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, and Charisma, and roughly +50% range on thrown explosives. Accepts Upgrade Patches (see I-028 Earth patch and later patch rows when printed). Exact AC uses table armor rules for a light magical jacket.

entries.tier: F5 Platinum Spicy (sample); Gold+ patch boxes
entries.flavor: Iron-on propaganda for your jacket. Smells like home-world cope.
entries.mechanics: Small patch. While sewn onto a valid patch chassis: +5% Strength and immunity to cloud-based attacks. Sewing may require a tool check.

entries.display_name: Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore
entries.tier: F1 Legendary Quadruped Box (canon); later reprints rare
entries.flavor: Who's a dirty girl? The crown already answered. Intelligence up, first impressions weird, infections optional.
entries.mechanics: Head slot. While attuned: +5 Intelligence; +5 to Good First Impression (treat as a social skill bonus); attacks have a chance to inflict a Sepsis-style lingering damage condition (GM table). Legendary one-off fantasy; Floor 1 house tiara card is a milder adaptation (cmi-003).

entries.tier: F4+ Prize Carousel / Fan Box path (unique)
entries.flavor: Chicken recipes, goblin recipes, and enough bad ideas to end a season. Unique. Sticky. Do not lend it out.
entries.mechanics: Unique book. Expands Scratchpad by +1 page and functions as a long-running quest/recipe macguffin. Not a random Silver pull.

entries.display_name: Ring of Not Dying as Often
entries.flavor: A plain band that quietly hates incoming dice. Attune it or enjoy being meat.
entries.mechanics: Requires attunement. +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn.

entries.flavor: Jump farther. Stick landings less often. Physics is optional; ankles are not.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. Jump distance is tripled; still needs a running start when the jump rules say so.

entries.display_name: Boots of Getting There Faster Than Your Friends
entries.flavor: Walking shoes for cowards who refuse to die tired. Springing included. Dignity sold separately.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. Walking speed becomes 30 feet if lower; jump distance tripled; hard landings from jumps are softened per SRD.

entries.display_name: Cloak of Please Stop Looking at Me
entries.flavor: Camouflage for people who peaked at hide-and-seek. The hood judges your posture.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks; you can attempt to hide when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.flavor: Jewelry that hates Magic Missile personally. Fashionable spite.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. Resistance to force damage; immunity to the Magic Missile spell.

entries.flavor: A pendant that bullies your blood into clotting. Stabilizes losers. Doubles hit-dice drama overnight.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. Automatically stabilize at 0 HP. Whenever you roll Hit Dice to regain HP, double the total.

entries.flavor: Hands that insist you are stronger than your character sheet. Gym optional.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. Your Strength score is 19 while worn (no effect if already 19+).

entries.flavor: A sweatband that does your thinking. Personality optional. Trivia night ruined.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. Your Intelligence score is 19 while worn (no effect if already 19+).

entries.flavor: Metal that refuses critical hits like a bad review. Heavy. Smug.
entries.mechanics: Any medium or heavy adamantine armor: critical hits against you become normal hits. This entry assumes breastplate form; AC as breastplate.

entries.flavor: Sharper, meaner, still a stick with opinions. The plus-one is the only honest thing about it.
entries.mechanics: Magic longsword with +1 to attack and damage rolls. (Deck already has +1 quarterstaff as mop; this is the edged cousin.)

entries.flavor: Throw once. Become the storm. Then it is a normal javelin again and you are still wet.
entries.mechanics: As an action, throw it: transforms into a 5-foot-wide, 120-foot-long lightning bolt line; each creature in line makes a DC 13 Dex save, 4d6 lightning on fail / half on success. Then the javelin returns to mundane form until next dawn.

entries.flavor: A polite knife until it is not. Poison optional; consequences mandatory.
entries.mechanics: +1 dagger. Action to coat: next hit before 1 minute ends DC 15 Con save or 2d10 poison damage. Recharges at next dawn.

entries.flavor: Disappear. Immediately do something loud. Become a parable.
entries.mechanics: Invisible for 1 hour (SRD). Ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

entries.flavor: Enlarge for the bit. Doorways will remember you.
entries.mechanics: Gain the Enlarge effect of enlarge/reduce for 1d4 hours (SRD potion).

entries.flavor: Blessings and temporary hit points in a bottle. Side effects include hubris.
entries.mechanics: Gain 10 temporary HP that last for 1 hour. For the same hour, you are under the bless spell (SRD).

entries.display_name: Elixir of Get Your Life Together
entries.flavor: Cures the debuff buffet. Does not cure your decision-making.
entries.mechanics: Cures any disease and removes blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and poisoned conditions (SRD).

entries.flavor: Seven charges of sticky architecture. Web the hallway. Web your problems. Web your friends by accident.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. 7 charges; cast web (save DC 15) for 1 charge. Regains 1d6+1 at dawn; on a 1 for daily regain, the wand is destroyed after the last charge is spent (SRD).

entries.flavor: A single-use teleport for cowards with good timing. Paperwork vanishes with you.
entries.mechanics: Spell scroll of misty step (2nd-level). Only casters who have the spell on their list can use it; then the scroll is destroyed.

entries.flavor: Say the command words. Get a trickle, a fountain, or a geyser. Flood a saferoom and enjoy the review.
entries.mechanics: Produces fresh or salt water on command: stream, fountain, or geyser rates per SRD. Geyser can shove creatures.

entries.flavor: Throw powder. Vanish with your closest mistakes. Duration varies because the System likes roulette.
entries.mechanics: Toss to coat yourself and nearby creatures: invisible for 2d4 minutes. Attacking or casting ends it early for that creature (SRD).

entries.flavor: A hat that lets you breathe underwater. Style remains a personal failure.
entries.mechanics: While worn, you can breathe underwater.

entries.flavor: A luckstone that makes failure look optional. Attune it and watch the dice unionize.
entries.mechanics: Attunement. +1 to ability checks and saving throws while carried.

entries.flavor: Clip-on power. Opens nothing important. Makes NPCs briefly assume you work here, which is worse.
entries.mechanics: Once per day, advantage on one Charisma check against Orientation Pit staff/usher-type NPCs. No door-opening magic; pure social scam.

entries.flavor: A token that smells like hot coils. Redeem for one free Bronze-tier wall pull. The machine still hates you.
entries.mechanics: Consume to draw once from the local Bronze loot table without spending credits. Nontransferable once slotted.
